stable_available_your_current_version_is: {{generator}}: stable {{result_version}} available. Your current version is preserved.
you_already_have_the_current_stable_vers: You already have the current stable version.
stable_component_installed_enable_it_in_: Stable component installed. Enable it in each game’s details.
stable_component_installed_configure_thi: Stable component installed. Configure this game to activate it.
the_game_must_have_launched_with_mako_to: The game must have launched with MAKO to accept live settings.
afmf_generates_one_in_between_frame_per_: AFMF generates one in-between frame per real frame (2×) with a Vulkan layer for Linux. Install it here, then choose which games use it.
generate_extra_frames_with_lossless_scal: Generate extra frames with Lossless Scaling. Prepare the component here, then choose which games use it.
enable_it_in_the_games_you_choose: Enable it in the games you choose
library_select_a_game_frame_generation: Library → select a game → Frame generation.
in_the_game_s_frame_generation_tab_choos: In the game's Frame generation tab, choose AFMF, enable it and adjust the options. Installing the component does not enable frame generation automatically.
choose_the_lossless_scaling_dll_set_the_: Choose the Lossless Scaling DLL, set the multiplier and enable it for that game. Installing the component does not enable frame generation automatically.
tested_on_amd_rx_7000_and_rx_9000_cards_: Tested on AMD RX 7000 and RX 9000 cards with RADV; needs Vulkan 1.1 and a 64-bit process. Independent project (afmf-linux, MIT license), not affiliated with AMD.
requires_the_public_steam_version_of_los: Requires the public Steam version of Lossless Scaling (Lossless.dll).
the_dll_is_not_included_in_this_download: The DLL is not included in this download.
removes_the_component_and_its_local_vers: Removes the component and its local versions. Game settings and the Lossless Scaling DLL are kept.
disable_the_component_in_games_and_apply: Disable the component in games and apply pending changes before uninstalling.
remove_and_all_versions_installed_by_pel: Remove {{generator}} and all versions installed by PeliGames? Game settings and your Lossless Scaling DLL will be preserved.
version_requires_a_peligames_integration: Version {{state_available_version}} requires a PeliGames integration update. The current version was preserved.
updates_preserve_older_versions_to_use_a: Updates preserve older versions. To use a backup, choose its version in the game's details.
flatpak_requires_an_extension_and_access: Flatpak requires an extension and access to the profile and DLL.
check_the_mako_dll_and_set_the_multiplie: Check the MAKO DLL and set the multiplier. Changes save automatically for the next launch.
enabling_mako_automatically_disables_afm: Enabling MAKO automatically disables AFMF for this game.
is_not_installed_install_it_in_settings_: {{mako}} is not installed. Install it in Settings → Add-ons.
choose_the_version_for_this_game_updates: Choose the version for this game. Updates preserve older versions.
requires_lossless_dll_from_the_default_p: Requires Lossless.dll from the default public Steam version of Lossless Scaling.
dll_on_another_filesystem_if_frame_gener: DLL on another filesystem. If frame generation does not work, Steam’s runtime may be blocking access. Try a copy in your home folder and select it here.
mako_is_not_enabled_in_this_profile_clos: MAKO is not enabled in this profile. Close the game to enable it.
game_running_adjust_multiplier_adaptive_: Game running: adjust multiplier, adaptive mode, target FPS, flow scale and lighter model here. DLL, version and activation require closing the game.
could_not_save_adjust_the_option_or_retr: Could not save. Adjust the option or retry.
steam_has_pending_changes_apply_configur: Steam has pending changes. Apply, configure manually or revert beside the Play button.
fine_tune_generation_and_check_compatibi: Fine-tune generation and check compatibility before enabling.
adjusts_extra_frames_to_the_scene: Adjusts extra frames to the scene.
configure_the_peligames_overlay_and_back: Configure the PeliGames overlay and background FPS limit in Performance. The overlay can run with MAKO disabled.
mangohud_may_count_only_real_frames_high: MangoHUD may count only real frames. Higher output FPS does not proportionally reduce input latency. Disable other frame generators before testing.
disable_hdr_for_this_stable_mako_integra: Disable HDR for this stable MAKO integration, configured for SDR. MAKO HDR is still experimental.
flatpak_uses_its_own_mako_extension_prep: Flatpak uses its own MAKO extension. Prepare / verify Flatpak before enabling.
register_this_installation_in_the_main_l: Register this installation in the main library to configure its launch.
disable_ml_frame_generation_in_advanced_: Disable ML frame generation in advanced options first.
